2025_122_jan_2025_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's Jan 2025 PCARD report is a purchasing-card transaction register presented to the Board of Education for its March 18, 2025 meeting, printed 3/13/2025 and running 27 pages. Each line records a transaction date, an abbreviated merchant description, the journal-entry label JAN 2025 PCARD EXP, a 15-digit budget unit, an account code, and either a charge or a credit; the dated activity spans 12/27/2024 through 1/27/2025. The register closes with a Subtotal of 222,100.39 in the Transaction Amount column against 5,991.55 in the Credits column, and Total Expenses of 216,108.84.

**What it is**
A monthly purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction register for the Troy School District covering January 2025, printed 3/13/2025 and carried on the Board of Education agenda for March 18, 2025. All 27 pages repeat the header TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, Jan 2025 and the column labels Transaction Description, JE Description, Budget Unit, A/C Code, Transaction Amount, Credits. Every line carries the same journal-entry description, JAN 2025 PCARD EXP. Dated activity spans 12/27/2024 through 1/27/2025, with 1/13/2025, 1/20/2025 and 1/27/2025 recurring heavily as posting dates.

**Coding pattern**
Budget units beginning 101 dominate the listing, with 700- and 701-series units used for student activity and building accounts, 122- and 120-series units for grant and special-education programs, 423-series units for equipment purchases coded 6410, 529-series units for a separately coded operation using account 7919, and 530/531-series units for early-childhood and community programs. Recurring account codes include 3120, 3190, 3210, 3220, 3410, 3430, 3450, 3510, 3710, 4120, 4220, 5000, 5110, 5310, 5610, 5910, 5990, 6410, 6460, 7410, 7910 and 7919.

**Spending categories**
Instructional supplies from Amazon, Staples, School Specialty, J.W. Pepper, Marshall Music and Lakeshore Learning make up the bulk of the line count. Professional development and conference registrations run to MASB, MASSP & MASC, MSBO, MACUL, MABE MI, MSVMA, Oakland Schools, LRP Publications and Math Recovery. Travel appears as Delta, American, Southwest, Allianz Travel, Hilton, Holiday Inn, Amway Grand, Soaring Eagle and Hyatt Regency Chicago charges. Operations and fleet spending covers Home Depot, Uline, Quill, Midwest Wheel, Maxi Auto, Kirk's Auto, Bayliss Tire, DTE Energy, Comcast, AT&T, Mitel Cloud and GoDaddy. Software and subscription items include Gimkit at 1,000.00, Imagine Learning at 1,800.00 and 240.00, Learning A-Z at 405.00, Wiris.com at 306.96, Nearpod at 120.00, Loom at 24.00, OpenAI at 20.00, Adobe at 21.19 and repeated Edpuzzle charges of 13.50.

**Credits**
Credit-column entries include 4,447.76 reversing an Apple Store charge, 510.00 from National Sch, 255.00 from UChicago Web, 150.00 from a WGI donation, 95.37 and 50.00 from Amazon, 68.70 from Sam's Club, 48.61 from Uber Eats, 41.09 from Maxi Auto, 27.29, 22.87, 20.34, 20.00 from Oakland Schools, 17.09, 12.70, 12.54, 8.72, 6.29, paired Hilton credits of 29.35, Holiday Inn credits of 7.80 and 7.20, and Delta credits of 10.99.

Transaction dates run from 12/27/2024 through 1/27/2025, with 1/13/2025, 1/20/2025 and 1/27/2025 appearing as heavy posting dates.
